messages:
IncidentBot: PAGER - High error rate detected: 502/504s on /v1/chat.generate (region: us-east-1). Alert window: 14:02-14:10 UTC. Severity: P1. Paging @eng-oncall.

Fiona Lee: on it. joining call. any initial customer hits?

SupportBot: Summary: 18 customers with elevated failures. Two enterprise customers (BetaCorp, GammaApps) reporting timeouts and degraded throughput. Error payloads: "cudaMalloc failed: out of memory" and gateway 502. Logs: https://logs.internal/redwood/3349995555

Greg Soto: looking at infra -> seeing frequent OOMs on model-worker nodes (nodegroup: infer-us-east-g4). GPU mem oscillating, then host OOMs. stack excerpt: 
```
[2026-03-15T14:04:12Z] model-worker[pid=7721]: cuda: driver API error 2 (out of memory)
[2026-03-15T14:04:12Z] model-runner: runtime panic: device memory exhausted
backtrace: attention_kernel_v1+0x1b4
```

Hector Alvarez: are these single big-batch requests or many concurrent small ones? I see spike in request concurrency paired with larger default batch_size=16 for some routes.

Nina Park: immediate mitigation idea: 1) reduce max_batch to 4 on risky routes, 2) enable small-context model variant (open-xl-smallctx) for in-region traffic, 3) temporarily enable autoscale +1 node to absorb load. Are we able to change batching at the gateway quickly?

Fiona Lee: do the throttles. please post commands so oncall can audit.

OpsBot: Executing commands per request: 
- `redwoodctl route update --path /v1/chat.generate --max-batch 4 --region us-east-1` -> OK
- `redwoodctl route redirect --from /v1/chat.generate --to model:open-xl-smallctx --percent 60 --region us-east-1` -> OK
- `redwoodctl infra scale nodegroup infer-us-east-g4 --delta +1` -> OK (provisioning)

DeployBot: AUTO-SAFE: paused ongoing quantized-attn rollout in us-east-1 (safety trigger: >5% errors).

Greg Soto: metric update: 5xx spike fell from 12% -> 3.2% within 2m after batch/throttle and redirection. latency p95 still elevated (~3.1s). provisioning extra node delayed (~5m).

Hector Alvarez: collecting heap and GPU metrics. initial core dump shows cudaMalloc failure inside attention kernel when tot_tensor_bytes > 22GB. Suspect memory accounting regression in attention_v1 when KV cache retention for long conversations is enabled.

Greg Soto: quick mitigation 2: enable KV cache truncation for routes with session.age > 10m. Command: `redwoodctl session policy set --truncate-kv 1024 --path /v1/chat.generate --region us-east-1` -> ran OK.

SupportBot: Customer impact tracking: Ticket INC-9001 created for BetaCorp (1200 failed requests), INC-9002 for GammaApps (410 failed). Notified AMs + SRE oncall.

Nina Park: I'm opening a hotfix branch (runtime/fix/gpu-mem-account) to add bounds checks in attention kernel and safer allocation path. Will run CI and canary in eu-west before us-east rollout.

Fiona Lee: great. @Greg keep collecting traces. @Hector keep cores + nvprof profiles — put artifacts in s3://incidents/3349995555/ for postmortem.

Greg Soto: cores uploaded. nvprof attached. Observed sequence: long chat session (seq_len ~ 12000 tokens) + repeated reply streaming -> huge KV growth -> allocation failure.

DeployBot: Canary plan scheduled: 5% traffic to patched runtime in eu-west-1 once green. If pass, escalate to 20% then full rollout.

Hector Alvarez: live dashboard: memory pressure reduced after KV truncation and batch throttle. OOM events per minute dropped from 7 -> 0.6.

Fiona Lee: handoff plan: I'll stay until 1800 UTC, then hand off to Nina (taking follow-ups on the patch). Next update in 20m or sooner on regression. Please add any customer comms to the incident thread.

SupportBot: Sent initial customer advisory to BetaCorp and GammaApps. Suggested workaround: set max_context to 8k tokens or use open-xl-smallctx.

Greg Soto: tests failing in CI for an edge case in kv_gc when streaming writes overlap with eviction; reproducer added to issue #IR-4342. Working on deterministic fix.

Fiona Lee: tagging post-incident tasks: 1) patch and rollout with canary, 2) add automated detection for runaway KV growth, 3) update runbook with explicit throttle steps + redwoodctl snippets, 4) customer RCA and crediting for BetaCorp.

IncidentBot: INCIDENT MITIGATED - error rate reduced to baseline after throttles + redirect; severity lowered to P2. Please follow post-incident review steps and file postmortem within 72h.

DeployBot: extra note — we will revert the paused quantized-attn rollout only after hotfix confirms memory accounting stable.

Fiona Lee: handing off to @Nina Park for patch rollout and postmortem writeup. Closing primary pager.

Nina Park: ack. will own next steps and ensure we communicate to GTM. Thanks team :heart:
